1. This is an application seeking condonation of delay in filing the present appeal.
2. For the reasons stated in the application, the delay of 7 days in filing the present appeal is condoned.

4. This is an appeal under section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 impugning the judgment dated 18.01.2023 passed by the learned Reference Court in LAC No. 681/2016 titled as Vijay Kumar vs. Union of India & Anr, seeking further enhancement of the compensation amount in respect of award No.12/2005-06 pertaining to the land acquired of Village Barwala, Delhi.

5. Mr. M.C. Verma, learned counsel appearing for the appellant submits that the issue raised in the present appeal is similar to the one raised in L.A. APP No. 138/2018 titled as Chander Bhan vs.
Union of India and Anr, which was listed before this Court on 13.08.2018 and was admitted on same day and is listed in the category of 'Regular Matters'.
6. Issue notice.
